_comment: Assay definition for the VESPA 18S V4 protocol (Owens et al. 2024,
Nat Commun 15:402) run through nf-helminth-amplicon's database mode.
The library is the same two-step Nextera construct as ampseq_helminth,
with the same tandem-duplicated AMPSEQ indices, so the library and
indexing sections are copied from it unchanged: splitting and
demultiplexing are primer-agnostic and work on the inner anchors alone.
What differs is what is NOT here. The protocol has no control plasmids
and no quantification standards, so there is no control tag (an empty
sequence) and no quantification section. Its reference is a database
release given with --reference_database, not a panel, and the primers
are checked against that release's manifest.
Use with --reference_database only. A panel run needs a control tag to
separate targets from control plasmids and will refuse this file.
name: vespa18s_v4
description: VESPA 18S V4 (29F / 21b8_I_R_Nmod), two-step Nextera PCR, tandem-duplicated dual indices; no control plasmids, no quantification standards

_comment: None: the protocol has no control plasmids.
Two-step PCR. PCR1 adds the Nextera overhangs to locus-specific primers;
PCR2 adds P5/P7 tails and the tandem-duplicated indices.
After orientation normalisation to the i5-forward strand, both indices
read in the same orientation as the index list: the i5 primer carries
the index forward, and the i7 primer carries its reverse complement,
which the top strand reverses back.
The 19bp mosaic end AGATGTGTATAAGAGACAG is shared by both overhangs, so
it cannot identify which end of a molecule is being read. The anchors
to use are the discriminating portions abutting each index window.
barcode_repeats 2 is the AMPSEQ tandem design; 1 is a conventional
single index at each end. Both are dual-index. The difference is that
the duplication is indel insurance: an indel makes one copy
uninformative and the other carries the read, and a frame slip yields
two copies that disagree, which is what detects it. With one copy
there is no second observation.
allow_indels is false regardless, because the i7 set's minimum edit
distance is only 2 - it tolerates one substitution but zero indels.
The index map encodes plate position: i5 gives the row (A-P), i7 the
column (1-24). So well is derived, never recorded.
Tuning rather than identity. Tightening these makes pre-flight fussier;
loosening lets more through.
Nominal per-base error rates, used to forecast tag detection in the
pre-flight report so a decoy that is reliable on Illumina but marginal
under a fast basecalling model is known in advance rather than
discovered in the data.
